_about: U-5: one concept, one word (D-177, D-520). For each settled concept, the word per language and the synonyms the lint rejects (tools/agents/usability-lint.mjs). A new settled term from 'Resuelto con el dueño' in docs/USABILIDAD.md goes here.

game.why: No minigames: only the Gran Final shortens games (the owner's rule).

hint.why: U-5: in English the 💡 that costs points is a hint, never a help (Dominorama cb0ce98d, Críptico e15582e1). Spanish ayuda/pista and Portuguese ajuda/dica are left to the usability review.
